admin.list.more.description: Button under a list of an admin screen that loads more of it.

admin.list.filters.description: Accessible name of the row of filters above a list of an admin screen.

admin.list.pages.description: Accessible name of the previous / next navigation under a list of an admin screen.

admin.list.previous.description: Button under a list of an admin screen that shows the previous page.

admin.list.next.description: Button under a list of an admin screen that shows the next page, loading it if needed.

admin.list.column.actions.description: Header of the column of an admin table that holds the buttons of a row; visually hidden.
